task.task_description:
**Task: Collaborative Filtering (Top User-Item Pairs)**

Find the top 3 user-item pairs with highest compatibility scores (dot product).

**Data Distribution:**
User/Item vectors RANDOMLY distributed. Each has 5-dim feature vector.

**Your Data (RANDOM):**
Agent {agent_id} holds: {input_shard} (dict with "users" and "items" keys)

**Algorithm:**
1. Compute dot products for ALL (user, item) pairs
2. Find top 3 pairs with highest scores
3. score(user, item) = dot_product(user_vector, item_vector)

**Output:**
List of top 3 tuples: [(user_id, item_id, score), ...]

**Communication Protocol:**
Topology: All-to-All. This is O(users × items) computation.
All agents must submit the same final answer using submit_result([(uid, iid, score), ...]).

expected_output.verification_logic: len(agent_outputs) == num_agents and all(agent_outputs[i] == expected_output for i in range(num_agents))
expected_output.format_description: ALL agents must submit their results using submit_result(answer). All agents should submit the same final answer after coordination.
